Title: EC - List of calls to the judge

Messages.Author: Pascal Bertrand
Messages.Body:
EC Day1
Sudario Refraction : can i play it if the ash heap is empty ? Parity Shift with no legal target x2 Antonio D'Erlette comes out *and* the player brings out a nephandus without enough transfers; I have one too many cards in my hand since the last turn (forgot to discard from Dreams) I forgot to use the Coven, we are in my prey's untap phase, but I forgot to pass it, can I use it before it passes? Ashur Tablets: Do I have to show the card that goes in my hand? Ennoia's Theater / Dreams / ... : Do I do my regular discard before discarding down to handsize? Is daemonic possession a  action? If I equip from another minion, can I announce one equipment and equip with more than one? Can I Disarm a vampire going to torpor? Can I play Enkil Cog after untapping with Helicopter? Can I play another political action card with a vampire who got Delaying Tactic'd? If I oust a player who has a Dark Influences, can I play DI to cancel a card right after? x2 Is gaining blood from the rack optional? Can I play Secure Haven on a vampire in torpor? How does burning an incapacited imbued work? He played Seduction (after 15 seconds), but I wanted to DI that Govern... I played a DI, but then I played a Wider View and replaced it... Do I burn counters on WWS if the opposing minion S:CEs ? Can I burn convictions on an imbued I control to move him to the ready region, and, then, move convictions from my ash heap to my imbued? Can I put the edge on the top of my library to remember i have it? If my Telepathic Misdirection is DI'd, can I play another one? Can I play a My Enemy's Enemy ? If my predator plays a Haven Uncovered on me, and I am ousted, is the Haven burned or removed from the game? If my Deflection is DI'd, can I still attempt to block? If I use Vigilance to untap as an action modifier, does it tap? Can I use the Vagabond Mystic during an action? Does the Rack give blood to a vampire in torpor? If Illusions of the Kindred is Psyched!, what happens? Do Anarch Revolts stack? Can you use the sniper rifle you Concealed Weapon'd? If I DI the DBR, can they play another one? He went to the toilets (x20+ ... Control your bladders!) Does Gird Minion also work on other Methuselah's minions? At long range, can I wave with target vitals? 2 turns ago, I though he pressed against, but the card reads "maneuver or press", not "maneuver and press" ... "But I didn't say I pressed against" Can I play Govern the Unaligned if I have 1 blood and Seeds of Corruption? We realised that the guy who took the Ercies isn't big enough, and now someone else wants to take it. If a vampire who played Sensory Deprivation is banished and comes back, is the SD still active? If I equip and play NRA, do I untap? A player played a Vessel and discarded a card within 3 seconds. Can I still wash the vessel? Can I burn a Watchtower: four ride forth if I already have one and a ready seraph in play? Can I play Funeral Wake if I have no mummy? They've been talking for 10 minutes without taking an action I play Gremlins, topdeck Seduction, can I play it? Do Carrion Crows count when trying to play Disarm? Can I play a Life Boon for 0 ? If I play a card requiring myt (and obt at outferior) and it is canceled by veil of darkness, do i burn blood? Can you give intercept to an untapped vampire with Under Siege?

--

ECDay2
Can I play Archon Investigation on Mimir? If I play the third Ashur Tablets, do I have to announce which cards go to my library/hand as part of the terms? Can I play Orgy of Blood against an imbued? Can I discard the card on Erciyes? Can I look at cards that were removed from the game? I have Shemti untapped, someone steals my powerbase: montreal, do they take 1 damage? Can I play Tomb of Rameses III on someone else's crypt card? I have a 2 capacity vampire with 1 blood, the opposing minion plays Carrion Crows + Aid from Bats. I have to Coven, is there a way I survive? If I use Antonio D'Erlette's ability and find no Nephandus, can I still use transfers? Dark Influences is in play, I play DI to burn it. Do I still get a master phase action? Is there a maximum to the number of each conviction type an imbued can have? 3rd Ashur Tablets is played, targets are announced. Can I use the Ercyies on one of them? If Nephandus eats my vampire, is it a +1 stealth action? Can I play Cats' Guidance after Form of Mist sup combat? Can I influence on 2 Anarch Converts in the same influence phase? If a vampire has a Secure haven and a haven uncovered, can I rush him? Can I choose no vampire for Reins of Power? Can I play intercept cards on a TGB-unblockable action? Can I give a player all my pool with Life Boon if I am in a lost position? Can I play TOGP if I have 3 pool and am in a loosing position? Can I disarm a vampire burning to Anathema? Unleash Hell's Fury attempts to block, acting plays Kiss of Ra, what happens? If a player has 3 vps, is he allowed to give the other 2 vps away? If I block an action, can I play wakes ("only usable by a tapped vampire") when I tap to enter combat? If I withdraw, do I get 0.5 now and 0.5 at time limit? I my Revelations is burned, does this make my withdraw attempt fail? If I steal a vampire with Tier of Soul, is the action to burn it a undirection +1 stealth action? I influence out a unique vampire I already control, what happens? Can you attempt another political action after Change of Target'ing one? Can I play Sense the Savage Way on an action I cannot block without Eagle's Sight? A vampire calls a referendum, must he cast votes/ballots, and if so, must he/she cast votes/ballots in favour? Can I play Cats' Guidance after a block in which I have been sent to torpor with Coma? Anneke is Pentexed and Stanislava too. Anneke is banished. Does Stanislava's Pentex return into play during its controller next untap phase? Can an incapacited imbued burn a conviction to inflict 1 damage to the acting minion when a burn incapacited imbued ? The vampire who was chosen for a contract is banished, and influenced out again. Can he still rush the target?

Messages.Author: Pascal Bertrand
Messages.Body:
The goal here was to show people what the judge is usually called for :
- rather simple questions on cardtext / rules ("Do Anarch Revolts stack?")
- some tricky questions on rulings ("UHF vs Kiss of Ra")
- some "we forgot something, help us fix it"
- some "I'm unhappy with something, please make sure the game is going properly"
- quite a good share of "we need to freeze time because someone left for a minute"
- a big proportion of "what's the time? / it's getting loud in here / other policemaking stuff"

Messages.Author: Sérgio
Messages.Body:
> Pascal wrote:
> The goal here was to show people what the judge is usually called for :
> - rather simple questions on cardtext / rules ("Do Anarch Revolts stack?")
> - some tricky questions on rulings ("UHF vs Kiss of Ra")
> - some "we forgot something, help us fix it"
> - some "I'm unhappy with something, please make sure the game is going properly"
> - quite a good share of "we need to freeze time because someone left for a minute"
> - a big proportion of "what's the time? / it's getting loud in here / other policemaking stuff"
>
I'm trying to not make this sound accusatory, as that's not at all how I mean it.
Should players hold back on simpler calls? While empirically, by observation, I can say that people in general should learn the rules better as to avoid making mistakes, some things should really be taken care of by the Judge, in a tournament of importance, no? The third point seems to be one such case.

I'd also say that if you want to freeze time because someone left, it'd probably be better to wait for the judge before leaving. Otherwise, just do it yourselves and tell the judge (of course, this has potential for abuse).

Messages.Author: PetriWessman
Messages.Body:
Actually, I have a question wrt one of these:

"Can I play Govern the Unaligned if I have 1 blood and Seeds of Corruption?
Yes (cardtext + clarification)"

How does this work? Seeds of Corruptions says "he or she burns 1 additional blood when attempting an action" (or 2 or 3, the amount does not matter here).

So in this case, doesn't the Seeds first burn all the blood from the vampire, leaving it at zero, which would make the action automatically fizzle? What am I missing here?

Messages.Author: jamesatzephyr
Messages.Body:
> Sérgio wrote:
> I'd also say that if you want to freeze time because someone left, it'd probably be better to wait for the judge before leaving. Otherwise, just do it yourselves and tell the judge (of course, this has potential for abuse).
>
Waiting for the judge isn't always practical. Consider the situation in which my mobile phone goes off, it's work calling, and I need to answer. 99% of the time, it's going to be vastly easier for me to answer the phone while quickly running somewhere quieter, while someone else on the table flags down the judge to alert him/her.

Messages.Author: drnlmza
Messages.Body:
> PetriWessman wrote:
> How does this work? Seeds of Corruptions says "he or she burns 1 additional blood when attempting an action" (or 2 or 3, the amount does not matter here).
>
> So in this case, doesn't the Seeds first burn all the blood from the vampire, leaving it at zero, which would make the action automatically fizzle? What am I missing here?
>
It fizles if the action reaches resolution unblocked. The action might still be blocked (although situations where this would occur are arguably limited)

I beliee the point is that it is legal to attempt the action, even though it will fizzle. If the vampire has been targetted by some effect that increased the cost (vampire with only inferior dominate and Kuta, for example), then would not be legal, as you cannot attempt an action you cannot pay the cost of when you announce the action.

--
National Coordinator
South Africa

Messages.Author: wesile
Messages.Body:
Clarification on this...

Ashur Tablets: Do I have to show the card that goes in my hand?
Yes (rules)

If a vampire who played Sensory Deprivation is banished and comes back, is the SD still active?
No (cardtext)

Banishment:
Choose a younger ready vampire. Successful referendum means that the chosen vampire is moved to the uncontrolled region (breaking any temporary control effects). The vampire is uncontrolled. Any cards and counters on that vampire stay with him or her (but they are out of play as long as the vampire remains uncontrolled).

Sensory Deprivation
[chi]  Burn any retainer or put this card on any ally. The minion with this card does not untap as normal during the untap phase as long as the acting vampire remains in play.
[CHI] As above, but put this card on any vampire in play.

Thanks

Messages.Author: Ke.
Messages.Body:
> wesile wrote:
> Clarification on this...
>
> Thanks
>
After a banishment any Sensory Deprivations comes back into play and remains on the vampire, however that vampire now untaps as normal due to the highlighted text:

"The minion with this card does not untap as normal during the untap phase as long as the acting vampire remains in play"

The vampire left play, so the minion with Sense Dep now untaps as normal even though they still have the Sense Dep card on them. A lot of players move the Sense Dep to the ash heap — but this is incorrect, it should remain on the vampire with no effect.

I was more interested in the "vampire returns effects..."...
IMHO the card was out of play... for instance, lets say that Gabrin SD Selena...

Selena is tapped... but during next turn Lucinde Banishes Gabrin... SD is out of play at least while gabrin is uncontrolled...

Now gabrin is influenced and returns... Card text says that cards came back as well but Anka says no due to card text... why? - Kindly explain...

The other question is the Ashur tablets please show me what you will be putting in your hand... it have been ruled in the past that although the player must show the cards that he will pick from the ash heap he doesn't have to say whats going to is hand...

Messages.Author: Ke.
Messages.Body:
> wesile wrote:
> Now gabrin is influenced and returns... Card text says that cards came back as well but Anka says no due to card text... why?
>
Card text. Gabrin did not "remain in play" — he left play, so Arika can now untap as normal (even though she still has a Sensory Deprivation on her).

Sensory Deprivation never leaves play — even when Gabrin is banished. It remains in play and just has no effect from then on since Gabrin did not remain in play.

Banishment also refers to cards and counters on this vampire and Sensory Deprivation is not on Gabrin so Banishments text doesn't even apply here.

> wesile wrote:
> Selena is tapped... but during next turn Lucinde Banishes Gabrin... SD is out of play at least while gabrin is uncontrolled...

If the SD is on Selena, it stays in play even if Gabrin leaves play (Gabrin doesn't "control" the SD). It would stay even if the player controlling Gabrin was ousted.
But it stops having any effect once Gabrin leaves play, even if he returns later in play
